## Parental OpControl 0.17.8

- The child’s own chat bubbles now use the mint green from the approved Luna mockup: Night sky `#3ddc97` with `#15103a` bold text, Moon gray `#14845a` with white bold text. The subject colour stays in the header icon, chat-list dots and math pictures.
- The child’s bubble keeps its shape and now includes a readable `You · time · status` line. The text is fully opaque and bold; the message text and the line use the same readable ink.
- The child now has an avatar next to their bubbles, the same size and alignment as Luna’s face: a flat vector face by default, plus cat, dog, fox, rocket, star, planet and robot. Tap the avatar or use the “…” menu to pick one; the choice is remembered on the device like the theme. Names are in English and es-MX.
- Contrast is at least 4.5:1 for the child text in both themes.
- This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated. Luna stays enabled with the same key.
